tier_reason: Raised C to B: the enricher reached the paper itself (ACM TOG 31(6), 2012) as LaTeX source with vector EPS figures in github.com/markkilgard/gpupathrender and derived the ratio tables from the chart data, so the measurement is peer-reviewed and no longer snippet-only. At 16 samples per pixel on a GeForce 650 with a 'fast Core i7', NV_path_rendering is 2.7-40x faster than Cairo, 2.1-34x than Skia's CPU backend, 1.6-78x than Skia Ganesh, 0.95-29x than Direct2D and 4.4-31x than WARP, with ratios falling as the window grows. Corrections: the 105x clipping figure is a separate GeForce 560M showcase, the chart's clipped scene is only 6.3-22x versus Cairo, the chart has no Qt row and OpenVG was compiled out of -xbenchmark. The nvpr_svg.cpp harness times CPU backends without the blit (favouring them) and the GPU with swap plus glFinish, vsync off; baking is excluded on both sides; benchmark.bat is stale (runs gs_bezier.exe). Not A: the renderer lives in NVIDIA's proprietary driver.

corrections.claimed_speedup: Paper chart data (ACM TOG 2012, LaTeX and EPS in markkilgard/gpupathrender; GeForce 650, 'fast Core i7', 16 samples per pixel, SVG scenes at 100x100 to 1100x1100; derived from chart vector data): NV_path_rendering 2.7-40x faster than Cairo 1.9.6, 2.1-34x than Skia CPU, 1.6-78x than Skia Ganesh, 0.95-29x than Direct2D and 4.4-31x than WARP, ratios falling with window size; the clipped scene is 6.3-22x versus Cairo. The 105x figure (8.69 ms versus Cairo 909 ms at 1000x1000) is a separate GeForce 560M showcase. No Qt row in the chart; OpenVG compiled out of -xbenchmark.
corrections.caveats: Peer-reviewed but first-party (NVIDIA authors) and the renderer is inside NVIDIA's proprietary driver, so only the SDK example code is public (reference). Harness nvpr_svg.cpp: CPU timing excludes the blit (favours the baselines), GPU timing includes swap and glFinish with vsync off, baking excluded on both sides; benchmark.bat is stale. Cairo 1.9.6 had a path-clipping bug per the SDK ReadMe. Qt 5.12 deprecated and Qt 6 removed the NvprRenderer. 2012 hardware and library versions.
